stops.text: Keep the surface clean and even. Minimal texture, but still visibly hand made.
Let the tool marks show. Slight texture, line weight that varies, colour not quite meeting the line.
Push the medium hard. Visible grain, misregistration by a millimetre or two, uneven ink coverage, paper showing through.
Treat the original as damaged. Ink pooling and skipping, registration out by several millimetres, creased and scuffed paper, an imperfect scan.
Almost nothing is moving. The interest is in stillness and attention.
Low key. One small thing is happening and the rest is settled.
Busy. Several things are happening at once and they are not coordinated.
Everything at once. Limbs mid movement, objects in the air, the moment about to get worse.
No text anywhere in the image.
Total text in the image: {v} words maximum, hand lettered in the same medium as the drawing. A misspelling makes the image a failure and it should be regenerated.
Cool light. Grey blue and pale lemon, no amber anywhere.
Neutral daylight, slightly cool, flat and even.
Mild warmth without going amber. Avoid the dim brown lamplit interior.
Warm light, but keep it clean and matte rather than golden. No glow.
{1} is the anchor of the composition and the others react around them.
Two of them carry the frame and the rest are doing something at the edge of it.
The whole cast shares the frame equally. No single lead.
